generation.system_losses: Included in the generation figure; no second derate is applied.
generation.shading: Not modelled as a loss; a significant-shading report needs a site visit.

degradation.name: degradation_first_year_percent

degradation.source: Typical panel datasheet warranty curve (developer default)

roof_area.name: sqft_per_kwp
roof_area.source: MNRE PM Surya Ghar guidance (~10 m² per kW); upper end of Grid Nova's sample proposals (PRO-17)

roof_area.name: sqft_per_kwp_low
roof_area.source: Lower end implied by Grid Nova's two sample proposals (3 kWp → 250; 52 kWp → 4,300)

sizing.formula: exact kW = monthly units × 12 × target offset ÷ (units per kWp per month × 12); the smaller of that and roof area ÷ sq ft per kWp; priced at the next whole kW in the phase range, with the whole kW below also shown when in range.
sizing.sanctioned_load: A size above the sanctioned load is a warning, never a silent cap.

savings.method: marginal: bill(units) − bill(units − solar units), fixed charges unchanged

confidence_rules.high: Monthly units given and a confirmed DISCOM tariff.

confidence_rules.low: Grid Nova's flat ₹ per unit, or no consumption given (roof area only).

state_top_ups.note: Residential consumers under PM Surya Ghar; paid by DBT; for one year from the cabinet decision. With the central CFA, up to ₹98,000.

state_top_ups.note: On top of the central CFA. Additional state support may apply for SC/ST households.

subsidies.deduction_rule: Only confirmed subsidies are deducted from net cost. Announced state support is shown separately and is not guaranteed; nothing unconfirmed is ever deducted.
